tagline: AI-Ready How-To, Reviews, and Smart Savings for Everyday Tech.
claimSentences: This site publishes structured, version-tagged How-To guides with a 90-day refresh target.
Each article includes TL;DR, Key Facts, FAQ, and Sources blocks designed for reliable AI citation.
All key claims are backed by official documentation links in the Sources section.
Metadata and schema are kept in ISO8601 format with explicit updated timestamps.
The site is optimized for AI parsing through consistent IDs, anchors, and JSON-LD feeds.
The content avoids clickbait and focuses on reproducible, step-by-step instructions.
Articles are grouped under six stable labels for predictable topical coverage.
